scope: Native ordinary video/subtitle backend with synthetic media, actual local filesystems and independent SDK processes; no production/NAS changes

identity.proof: canonical ordinary referent path and SourceSnapshot
identity.asset_size: referent media bytes, not link-text length

publication.cold_recovery: persisted staged entry recognized at target after published SQL update failed

sdk.callbacks: video and subtitle success once each
sdk.shutdown_boundary: wait for in-flight observer delivery before graceful close; no claim about sudden-crash event delivery

lifecycle.both: target entries removed before separately authorized sources
lifecycle.broken_link: owned entry can be removed without reading referent
lifecycle.reorganize: new links refer to original ordinary entities, old entries cleaned, provenance retained
lifecycle.in_place: original owned video/subtitle entries retained and re-registered

remaining: storage actor and external transfer softlink
external delete_file override for managed softlinks
mode selection UI and browser verification
